Brief-claimed-by: session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb · batch #406 · 2026-10-27T02:57Z

Director seat, summon #51 continuation (ledger objectstack#12708). Presented to the maintainer in batch #406 as item 1 of 1. Seat increment (re-verified on `origin/main` `e677770a`; the card is not restated):
- P2 holds: `authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts` (150 lines) imports only `node:fs` / `node:path` and the ledger module — no app, no build; `authz-conformance.test.ts` (2,050 lines) imports `checkLedger` from `@objectstack/verify`, so it needs that package's build closure. P3 holds: `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs:11522` prints the "⛔ does NOT run on this PR or in the merge queue" line. The ruling the card narrows is in `ci.yml:120–135`: the three jobs carry `github.event_name != 'pull_request' && github.event_name != 'merge_group'` by design (#24073). The fix PR #26406 (+37/−14) is still open at this stamp; #26400 is p0 `pm:dispatched`.
- **A's mechanics have one constraint the card does not name:** a job with its own `paths:` cannot be a required context — `check-required-contexts.mjs:265–275` excludes `Spec property liveness` for exactly that reason (PRs touching no such path sit pending forever). So A as "a new path-triggered job" is advisory only, or always-run. The shape that is both required and cheap is **a filter-gated step inside an existing required context** (`Lint & Repo Gates` for the file-reading census; `Test Core` for the one that needs `@objectstack/verify` built): no new context, no new job, no enrolment, and the red lands on the author's PR. The seat presents A in that shape; the lane picks the job.
- Local runtime of the two files not measured by this seat (no installed workspace in this container); the file-reading census is seconds by construction, the conformance file costs the `verify` closure build that `Test Core` already pays.
- Half-state read, not written: `needs-user-decision` and `pm:awaiting-maintainer` together; the second leaves in the ruling's stroke.
- Facets (the card's block, re-read): ① A+C moves a check to where the change is made and makes it measure classification, not a count; #24073 stands for the heavy legs. ② three main reds in ten days, 2.5 h this time, release cut refused meanwhile. ③ A refuses on the PR loudly; B relies on a warning P3 shows was missed. ④ A is a new gate in substance (the maintainer's yes is needed even as a step); C rewrites an existing test, no key.
- The seat agrees with **A + C**, A as a step inside an existing required job (filter-gated on `packages/rest/src/**`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/**`, `packages/qa/dogfood/test/authz-*`), not a new job. Not B alone (the same local warning that was missed three times). Workload: A devx · 1 PR, Tier H (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`), no measured precedent in hand for a filter-gated step; C devx · 1 larger PR on the two census files (2,200 lines read), no precedent.
Prior rulings read: dogfood PR merge_group skip · authz census → #24073, #22653; 「新增门禁默认否」; 「平台测试清单反复变红，肯定要修啊」; ADR none; thread: #26400 (6432031749).

Ruling: batch #406 item 1 · letters A + C · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-27T03:18Z

Recorded by the director seat (summon #51 continuation, `session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708). The maintainer answered batch #406 with 「同意」 — the seat letters. Brief 6432627947. **A + C**, and the maintainer's yes is the explicit flip of 「新增门禁默认否」 for this one check:

- **A — the static authz census runs on the PR and in the merge queue, as a filter-gated step inside an existing required context, not as a new job.** Trigger paths: `packages/rest/src/**`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/**`, `packages/qa/dogfood/test/authz-*`. The file-reading census (`authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts`) belongs in `Lint & Repo Gates`; the one that imports `@objectstack/verify` (`authz-conformance.test.ts`) in `Test Core`, where that closure is already built — the lane picks the exact job and says so in the PR body. ⛔ Not a new job with its own `paths:` (it could never be enrolled as a required context: `check-required-contexts.mjs:265–275`), and ⛔ no change to the three heavy legs' `if:` — #24073 stands. The red lands on the author's PR.
- **C — the census derives its population from the route ledger and goes red only on a route with no classification (`reachable` / `blindSpot`)**; a bump-only change (a docblock `{@link}`, a reordered registration) no longer reds anything.
- Not B alone: the same local warning (`dispatch-gates.mjs:11522`) was missed three times; B's local command may ride along in C's PR if the lane finds it free, but it is not the gate.

Workload (card columns): A devx · 1 PR, Tier H (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`; lands by the maintainer's approval) · size S; C devx · 1 larger PR on the two census files (150 + 2,050 lines read) · size M; no measured precedent for either. Order: C may land first or together; A's step runs whatever census shape exists on its head. The in-flight fix PR #26406 (#26400, p0) is not displaced by this ruling.

Execution: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in this act (`domain:devx`, p1, `area:devpath`); `pm:awaiting-maintainer` removed in the same stroke. The devx seat dispatches two cards or two PRs under this card, each citing `Ruling-ref:` this comment. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Ruling: batch #406 item 1 · re-ruled A + C → C only · maintainer 「c」 2026-10-27T03:27Z

Recorded by the director seat (summon #51 continuation, `session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708). After the 「同意」 that recorded A + C (6432893116) the maintainer asked 「这个测试增加的耗时划算吗？这个是必要测试吗？」; the seat measured and answered, then the maintainer wrote 「c」. **This re-rules the card to C only; A is withdrawn and 「新增门禁默认否」 stands unflipped — no census step runs on PRs or in the merge queue.**

What the measurement showed (the seat's reading, for the lane):
- All three main reds (#24057, #25988, #26361 → #26400) were `authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts`, whose own header says it is ⛔ not an authorization gate and classifies nothing: a measurement pin holding the hand-written census table `authz-probe-blind-spot.census.ts` (1,670 lines) equal to source counts. None was the real gate (`authz-conformance.test.ts`'s `discover()` UNCLASSIFIED / STALE verdict); 0 such reds in the 200 newest cards. The fix PR #26406 is +33/−12 in that table for one new route.
- A would have run on about 9% of PRs (30 of 338 commits in 30 days touch the trigger paths) for seconds, but guards a class with zero occurrences in the sample, while fixing none of the three reds.

**C, concretely:** the census derives its population from the route ledger; the hand-written census table and the count pin go (the cheapest form of C — derive what `authz-conformance.test.ts` needs instead of pinning a transcription of it), so no author edits a 1,670-line table to add a route, and a bump-only change (a docblock `{@link}`, a reordered registration) reds nothing. The `discover()` ratchet keeps refusing an unclassified route on `main`'s push and scheduled runs, as today (#24073 stands). The lane re-reads the other readers of the census path (`rest-route-ledger.ts`, `route-ledger.ts`, `rest-meta-auth.test.ts`, `dispatch-gates.mjs`) before deleting; a reader that needs the table rather than a comment pointer is reported, not forced.

Workload: devx · 1 PR · the two census files and the table (150 + 2,050 + 1,670 lines read) · size M · no measured precedent. Not Tier H unless `dispatch-gates.mjs` wording moves (`scripts/pm/**` is a seat-protocol surface; the lane declares it). `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Execution: the card stays `pm:queue` (devx p1); the devx seat dispatches **one** card thread for C and ⛔ none for A. If a real UNCLASSIFIED red ever lands on `main`, a new card is filed then with the count. `Ruling-ref:` names this comment; 6432893116 is superseded for A.

Open draft #26337 (another project, ADR-0142 phase 2) also edits `authz-conformance.matrix.ts` and `route-ledger.ts`: whichever lands second merges `main`
